description: This file defines an interface and an abstract base class related to type manifest providers within the Orleans serialization configuration. It includes interface inheritance, method implementations, and class properties relevant to configuring type manifest options.

classes.name: TypeManifestProviderBase
classes.description: An abstract base class for generated type manifest providers, implementing the ITypeManifestProvider interface and providing a default implementation for configuring options.

methods.name: ConfigureInner
methods.description: An abstract method that subclasses must implement to configure the provided TypeManifestOptions.

methods.name: Key
methods.description: A virtual property returning the unique identifier for this provider, defaulting to the runtime type.
